name: Numbered Hotbar Slots
summary: Shows a small number on every hotbar slot, so you always know which key picks which slot.
logoPrompt: A chunky stone-grey hotbar slot frame seen from the front, holding a small golden key, with a tiny glowing white pixel marker in its top-left corner

cover.tagline: Know your hotbar keys at a glance.

description: **Numbered Hotbar Slots puts a small digit from 1 to 9 into the corner of each hotbar slot, so you can see which number key picks which slot.**
- Every hotbar slot shows its number in the top-left corner, in light grey with a dark shadow like the game's own text.
- The digits are tiny and pixel-exact, so the hotbar keeps its vanilla look.
- Items are drawn on top of the numbers, so no icon, stack count or durability bar is ever covered.
- The selection frame is untouched, and the number stays visible inside it.
Put the zip into the `resourcepacks` folder of your game, then turn it on under Options > Resource Packs. Press the number keys and watch the frame jump to the matching slot.
- Made for Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3. It only replaces the hotbar texture, so you can add or remove it at any time.
- An item that fills the corner of its slot hides part of the number; empty slots always show it.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
